scope: Offline014 conclusion and future-version task-contract prerequisite only

futureContractPrerequisite.versionBoundary: Any such change is a task-contract decision, not an AMKernel/skill fix; original frozen tasks and scores remain unchanged.

currentProhibitions: No task replay, new task, Appium session, device query, or service restart
